title: VISPA: Pluralistic Alignment via Automatic Value Selection and Activation
benchmark_measurement: Ability to represent and steer model responses according to a diverse set of values, including non-WEIRD moral and spiritual constructs such as Karma, Spirituality, Ubuntu, and Confucianism.
findings: The VISPA framework was found to be effective in steering large language models to represent a broad set of pluralistic values. This includes non-WEIRD moral and spiritual constructs such as Karma, Spirituality, and Confucianism, which are often underrepresented. The main results are not disaggregated by value category, but the overall success of the framework implies improved representation for these faith-related perspectives.
